activation.description: The stage where a user first gets real value (the 'aha' moment). Must be one of the funnel stages.

audience.description: b2b (companies and the people in them) or b2c (individual users).

auto_approve.description: Which AI drafts go out without your click (sales term: autonomy). Flagged drafts always wait.

cold.description: none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

content.description: Same as cold. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

lifecycle.description: Same as users. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

outbound.description: Same as cold. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

users.description: none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

autonomy.description: Same as auto_approve. Which AI drafts go out without your click (sales term: autonomy). Flagged drafts always wait.

cold.description: none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

content.description: Same as cold. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

lifecycle.description: Same as users. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

outbound.description: Same as cold. none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

users.description: none | follow_ups | all (sales: manual | first_step | auto).

claims.description: What drafts may say about the product.

allowed.description: Markdown file listing true claims with proof links; drafts may only use these.

never.description: Phrases a draft may never contain.

demo.description: Demo data: only loads in sandbox mode.

fit.description: Scoring rules: each adds its weight if the person or company has any of the facts (e.g. dep:bullmq, lang:typescript).

any.description: Facts as kind:value, e.g. dep:bullmq, lang:go, team:5-50.

exclude.description: Matching people are never targeted by cold automations.

weight.description: Points added when any fact matches (1-100).

funnel.description: Ordered stage names, your product's pipeline (e.g. reached, replied, signup, activated, paid). Product events with a matching type record the stage.

icp.description: Same as target. Who it's for, in plain sentences (sales term: ICP). Used in prompts; fit rules make it machine-checkable.

include.description: Who it's for, one sentence each.

id.description: Folder name; lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

cold_per_day.description: Most cold messages per day for this product (sales: outbound_per_day).

outbound_per_day.description: Same as cold_per_day. Most cold messages per day for this product (sales: outbound_per_day).

touches_per_person_per_week.description: Most messages one person gets per week, across products.

notify.description: Your product's endpoint that delivers push/in-app messages (signed requests).

offer.description: The one concrete thing every message asks for.

cta.description: The call to action every message ends with.

destination.description: https URL of the next step (tracked links point here).

promise.description: What you promise to help with.

success_event.description: Funnel stage that counts as success for this offer.

window.description: How long to wait for success before judging, e.g. 14d.

one_liner.description: What it does, in one sentence.

cold.description: Mailbox for cold email (sales: outbound), ideally on a separate domain.

lifecycle.description: Same as users. Mailbox for email to existing users (sales: lifecycle).

outbound.description: Same as cold. Mailbox for cold email (sales: outbound), ideally on a separate domain.

users.description: Mailbox for email to existing users (sales: lifecycle).

target.description: Who it's for, in plain sentences (sales term: ICP). Used in prompts; fit rules make it machine-checkable.

include.description: Who it's for, one sentence each.

voice.description: Markdown file with tone notes and example messages.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp Cloud API sender, for kind: users sequences.
